purpose: Expose the existing canonical LearningMemory change→observed consequence→decision model through the normal Song work experience so the artist can record one concrete change tried in a real work Session, append what they actually observed with conditions/confounders/confidence, and make a KEEP/REVERT/REVISE/INCONCLUSIVE decision without claiming that the change caused the outcome.

lineage.outcome: The artist can preserve what they changed, what they observed afterward, and what they decided, so N0TE learns from real work without turning correlation into fake causality.

why_now: REQ-SCOPE-126 is a required minimum and explicitly records CORE-02C/E as foundation implemented while cross-domain consumer workflows remain downstream. LearningMemory already owns append-only Song/Session-bound episodes, observed consequences, conditions, confounders, source evidence, confidence, terminal decisions and Activity events. The missing seam is consumer use, not another experiment ledger.
instead_of: DO IT/WITH ME/SHOW ME interaction modes are not selected because REQ-SCOPE-124 still needs a distinct collaboration-depth product model rather than a simple reachability seam.
First-class reference objects are not selected because live N0TE2 still lacks the persistent Reference model required by REQ-SCOPE-115.
Full loudness-aware A/B and musical derivation remain unselected because there is no truthful clean-room loudness/audio-analysis substrate.

More Skill adjacency is not selected because the Skill Model is now consumer-visible and correctable; Learning decision memory is the next separate already-built foundation with high cross-product leverage.
Another DAW chassis increment is not selected because this learning loop is host-independent and can capture decisions made around any DAW or manual creative work.

legacy_rejections: client-submitted internal episode IDs as authority
global rule creation from one episode

completion_proof: from the exact active Song and exact open work Session, the artist can start a bounded Learning episode naming domain, subject and the concrete change tried
the artist can append one or more USER_DECLARED observations with explicit confidence and optional conditions/confounders; server owns source_ref and internal episode/consequence identity
consumer copy and data model say observed after the change rather than caused by the change; no causal claim or success rule is manufactured
a terminal KEEP/REVERT/REVISE/INCONCLUSIVE decision requires at least one observed consequence, explicit rationale and confidence
decision authority binds the exact episode and exact rendered consequence state so a stale page cannot decide without seeing a newer observation
once decided, no further consequence or second decision can be appended; history remains immutable and inspectable
new-episode authority binds exact active Song + exact open Session; stale Song/Session state, replay, foreign Origin and bad CSRF fail closed
the Song surface shows prior episodes, observations, conditions/confounders and decisions in artist language without exposing internal IDs/source refs
canonical Activity gains Learning episode/consequence/decision events while Song Version/material/approval, Skill state, Session scratch, Focus, Operations, DAWs and providers remain unchanged
quit/relaunch preserves the Learning history and any open undecided episode
authored HTTP/security/stale-state/invariant/restart proof remains separate from executed evidence; absent hosted execution is UNOBSERVED
next_selection_rule: After this increment lands or blocks, globally reselect. Compare interaction/teaching modes, Success/Friction consumer reachability, references, fuller Compare/A-B, Creative Studio, audio-analysis substrate, DAW/OPS and other portfolio outcomes.
